name: lucid
description: Lucid used standalone (no AdonisJS application), through its Database, BaseModel and managed-transaction APIs.

modes.description: Lucid's defaults, with the managed transaction API db.transaction(callback).
An application-level mitigation (reused experiment LT1c): the transaction callback ends with `select 1`, so an aborted transaction throws instead of returning.

unsupported.TX-04.independent-inner: Lucid has no propagation modes: a nested trx.transaction() is always a savepoint, and an independent transaction is an unrelated db.transaction() on another connection, which this case does not test.
